runtime_dependencies.change: All dependency image layers, environment variables and entrypoints are retained. Only Vflash package/source layers and version labels change.

qualification.package: All 59 installed package files match the build revision in each image. CPU installation, CLI, native service construction, UID 10001 writable cache/dlopen and pipeline adapter/media imports pass without GPU access.
qualification.wide_index: The installed fused module is byte-identical to the GPU-tested fix. Fifteen small/wide operator checks pass bit-for-bit, with safe chunks of the original arithmetic as the wide oracle. On one RTX 4090 48 GB, saved 243-frame conditioning completes eight Ref evaluations, finite FP32 audio/video latents, 240-frame 1344x768 media with stereo 32 kHz audio, and cleanup. This is not a full-trajectory bitwise comparison.
qualification.dual_sm86_t2: The new fixed Base4 v1.0 native profile uses two RTX 3080 20 GB GPUs, sequence-head and block streaming. Its compiler passes 52 same-architecture timestep/modulation comparisons. The installed native session completes application-owned conditioning/core/media requests at 928x512 for 5 seconds and 640x352 for 10 seconds, both 24 fps, including 14 finite conditions, FP32 audio/video outputs and close.
qualification.reuse: Existing five-second H3Pipeline qualifications remain attached to their original workloads. The new dual-SM86 T2 H3Pipeline wrapper was not rerun on GPU; long-duration checks use application-owned stages and saved conditioning where stated.
qualification.limits: No new speedup, clean timing or broad semantic/audio quality claim. Dual-SM86 T2 measurements included thermal throttling. H3Pipeline remains five seconds at 24 fps. No single-SM86 T2, tensor-strategy T2, T2 Turbo8, SM86 reference video or arbitrary long/high-resolution qualification.
